prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA atlas 1536x1024 for a hand-crafted paper pop-up battle stage. Twelve isolated asset cutouts, exact 4 columns by 3 rows, clean transparent gutters at least 24px. No grid lines or text. Every part entirely inside its cell.
STYLE PRIORITY: visibly thin colored paper sheets, elaborate 2D paper theatre illustration, overlapping flat silhouettes with fine cream cut edges, graphic hatching, creases and small pasted paper facets. Rich detailed craftsmanship but not realistic stone, not a 3D miniature, not bulky low-poly blocks. Frontal camera, barely any top-down perspective. Narrow contact shadows only between paper laminations. No fuzzy ambient background or glow clouds, no shadows on an invisible ground. Empty pixels truly transparent. No characters, ball, UI, logos, labels or watermarks.
Theme: Pokémon Emerald Terra Cave, ancient volcanic chamber. Charcoal black, dark umber basalt, rust-red creases, small ochre mineral flakes. Lava consists of visibly cut orange/red/yellow paper layers, bright saturated but no bloom.
Row 1 left to right:
1. Tall narrow LEFT basalt cliff silhouette of six overlapping irregular thin charcoal paper slabs; a subtle warm orange paper seam peeks between two slabs, fine mineral line drawings.
2. Different tall RIGHT basalt cliff silhouette with offset paper strata, sparse rust/ochre patches, NO lava waterfall attached.
3. Jagged distant dark-umber/black cave ridge with asymmetrical silhouette and many layered pointed paper strips, thin red slivers between some.
4. Hanging fringe of five short irregular charcoal and russet stalactite PAPER teeth, separate layers with a narrow uneven top strip.
Row 2:
5. One narrow vertical LAVA ribbon, wavy red-orange paper strips inset with thin yellow highlights, lobed folded lava edge at bottom, no rocks.
6. Broad low horizontal lava-flow cutout of winding orange-red-yellow layered paper ribbons with some black crust shards on top; no surrounding rocks or backdrop.
7. Low dry basalt ledge with flat grey-umber top, thin laminated front strata and tiny ochre mineral chips, no lava.
8. Several curled warm grey smoke PAPER ribbons rising from one narrow base, subtle creases and distinct opaque paper shapes, no airbrushed cloud.
Row 3:
9. Low angular collapsed basalt outcrop, six thin overlapping grey/brown paper facets and small pebbles, no lava.
10. Two small volcanic vent cones made of folded charcoal paper with tiny red slit openings, low and broad; visibly folded paper not sculpted stone.
11. Three separate curled paper embers in orange, coral and gold, varying shapes, each well apart and independently croppable.
12. Short lava bubble splash made of irregular flat orange/yellow paper arcs and two detached small droplets, no surrounding terrain.
Detailed and restrained: red/orange motion pieces stay separate from the charcoal rocks so each can animate independently. Exactly twelve isolated cutouts.
